questions.question: Who got the 1998 Nobel Prize in Economics?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Amartya Sen__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Amartya Sen:**

__
 
• He was born on **3 November****** 1933** in Shantiniketan, West Bengal.**
 
• Amartya Sen was awarded by the **Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel in 1998** for his work on **'Welfare Economics'.**
 
• Prominent books are written by him:
 
 
• **The Argumentative Indian, 2005**
 
• **The Idea of Justice, 2009**
 
• **The Country of First Boys and Other Essays, 2015.**
 
 
 
• **​In 1999**, he **received India's Bharat Ratna award** for his contributions to welfare economics.
 
• He also received **the Peace Prize in the German Book Trade in 2020.**

**Nobel Prize on Economics (**Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences**):**

 
• It was **started in 1969** in memory of Alfred Nobel.
 
• It was awarded by **t****he Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences, Stockholm, Sweden.**
 
• The **first Nobel** in Economic Sciences was awarded to **Ragnar Frisch and Jan Tinbergen.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Paul Samuelson
 
 
 
• He gave the **growth-oriented definition of Economics.**
 
• He is known as the **founder of Modern Economics.**
 
 
 
 

 Alfred Marshall
 
 
 
• A prominent economist from Britain.
 
• Popularly known for his book **'Principles of Economics'.**
 
 
 
 

 Robert Solow
 
 
 
• He is an American economist.
 
• He was the **first to develop a growth model with different vintages of capital.**
 
• He was awarded the **Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in 1987.**

questions.question: Who among the following won the National Film Award for Best Choreography at the 67th National Film Awards?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Raju Sundaram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raju Sundaram ** won the National Film Award for Best Choreography at the 67th National Film Awards.

 
 
• **Indian dancer, actor, and director Basava Raju Sundaram predominantly produces dance choreography **for Tamil, Kannada, and Telugu films.
 
• He acted in **movies including Jeans (1998), 123 (2002), I Love You Da (2002), and Quick Gun Murugun (2009)**.
 
• He also** directed **one movie,** Aegan (2008)**.
 
• He is the** elder brother of choreographers Prabhu Deva and Nagendra Prasad and the son of dancer Mugur Sundar**.
 
• At the** 67th National Film Awards, he received the National Film Award for Best Choreography for a song from "Maharshi" (2019)**.
 
• The song was performed by **Vedala Hemachandra and Vishnupriya Ravi and was titled "Everest anchuna." **
 
• **Sri Mani **wrote the** song's lyrics, and Devi Sri Prasad composed the melody**.
 
• Other Telugu movies choreographed by Raju Sundaram include "Republic," "Krack," "Saaho," "Bharat Ane Nenu," and "Gudumba Shankar."
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 67th National Film Awards 

 
 
• **​**The 67th National Film Awards were presented on **March 22, 2021, at a press conference to recognise the top Indian films certified in India between January 1, 2019, and December 31, 2019**.
 
• The awards event, where the** Directorate of Film Festivals honours the best in Indian cinema with its yearly National Film Awards**, was initially scheduled for **3 May 2020 but was postponed because of the COVID-19 pandemic**.
 
• Later, on **October 25, 2021**, it was delivered.
 
• At **Vigyan Bhawan in New Delhi**, the **67th National Awards **are being distributed.

questions.question: Who was the first Indian composer to win the Grammy Award?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Ravi Shankar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sitar maestro Pandit Ravi Shankar will be honoured with a Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award posthumously, organizers of the Recording Academy announced, the first Indian to get the prestigious award.
 
• The award would be presented on February 10 at the 55th Grammy Awards ceremony in Los Angeles.
 
• Shankar was a true pioneer in introducing Indian music to the West, he said, adding the music icon influenced artists across classical, jazz, pop, rock, and world music genres, including the Beatles, John Coltrane, Philip Glass, and his daughters, Norah Jones and Anoushka Shankar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Grammy Award, any of a series of awards presented annually in the United States by the National Academy of Recording Arts & Sciences.

 
 
• Winners are selected from more than 25 fields, which cover such genres as pop, rock, rap, R&B, country, reggae, classical, gospel, and jazz, as well as production and postproduction work, including packaging and album notes.
 
 
 
• Anoushka Shankar is a British Indian sitar player and composer.
 
 
• She is the daughter of Pandit Ravi Shankar

questions.question: Which Asian country hosted the first common wealth games?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Malasiya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **1998, Kuala Lumpur in Malaysia** hosted the games for the first time in an Asian country.
 
• In **2010**, the Games returned to Asia and were held in **Delhi**.

**About Commonwealth Games:**

 
• The Commonwealth Games is **an international sporting event.**
 
• It is held **every four years **in which different teams in the Commonwealth can participate.
 
• Apart from** 1942 and 1946, during the war, it has been continuously held since 1930.**
 
• From** 1930 to 1950, it was known as the British Empire Games.**
 
• But since then it has been renamed the **Commonwealth Games **as athletes from all across the Commonwealth of Nations will take part.

** Host countries:**

 
• Malaysia was the **eighth nation** to host the Commonwealth Games after **Canada, England, Australia, New Zealand, Wales, Jamaica, and Scotland.**
 
• It was held in the year **1998.**
 
• It was the** first Asian country** to hold a Commonwealth game
 
• It started on **11 September and ended on 21 September.**
 
• There were a total of **3638 participants.**

**Thus, Malaysia hosted the first Commonwealth games among Asian countries.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information:__**

 
• **First **Commonwealth Games were held in **Canada.**
 
• **India hosted** in the year **2010.**
 
• In **2026 **it will be held in **Australia.**

questions.question: Which Indian musician was awarded the Grammy award for his Album ‘Planet Drum’?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Zakir Hussain**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Zakir Hussain** is the Indian musician who was awarded the **Grammy award **for his album '**Planet Drum**'.
 
• 'Planet Drum' is a world music album that features a collaboration of various international percussionists and drummers, showcasing diverse rhythms and styles.
 
• Released in **1991**, the album won the Grammy Award for Best World Music Album in 1992.
 
• Zakir Hussain is renowned for his virtuosity in playing the **tabla **and has significantly contributed to the global recognition of Indian classical music.
 
• He has collaborated with various artists across different genres, further enhancing his influence in the world music scene.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zakir Hussain** was born on March 9, 1951, and is the **son of the legendary tabla player Alla Rakha**.
 
• He began his career in the early 1970s and quickly established himself as a leading tabla player.
 
• In addition to his Grammy win for 'Planet Drum', he has received numerous other awards and honors, including the **Padma Shri and the Padma Bhushan** from the Government of India.
 
• He is also known for his work with the **band Shakti**, alongside guitarist John McLaughlin, which blends Indian classical music with jazz influences.
 
• Zakir Hussain continues to perform and teach, inspiring new generations of musicians around the world.

questions.question: Cricketer Virat Kohli was honoured with Arjuna Award in the year ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2013**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Virat Kohli **received the Arjuna award in **2013**.
 
• He received Padma Shri in 2017 and the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award in 2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arjuna Award:**

 
 
• The Arjuna Awards were instituted in **1961 **by the Government of India to recognize outstanding achievement in National Sports.
 
• The award is given for good performance over a period of the previous four years and for showing qualities of leadership, sportsmanship and a sense of discipline.
 
• The award carries a cash prize of **Rs 15 lakh**, **a bronze statue of Arjuna and a scroll of honour.**

questions.question: Which of the following personalities received all three awards Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri in his/her life?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mary Kom**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mary Kom has received all three Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri in her life.**
 
• She was honoured with the **Padma Vibhushan,** India's second-highest civilian award, **in 2020** by President Ram Nath Kovind.
 
• She has already won the **Padma Bhushan in 2013** and the **Padma Shri in 2006.**
 
 
• She is the first amateur athlete to win the Padma Bhushan.
 
 
 
• Apart from** Mary Kom, ****Viswanathan Anand **are the only other players to have been honoured with **all three Padma Awards.**
 
 
• **​**Sachin Tendulkar is also the only player who was awarded the Bharat Ratna (in 2014).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Mangte Chungneijang Mary Kom (M. C. Mary Kom)**

 
 
• She belongs to the Churachandpur district of Manipur in India.
 
• She was nominated in 2016 by the President. She had served as a member of the Rajya Sabha from 25 April 2016 - 24 April 2022. 
 
• She is a renowned athlete and face of **women boxing** in India. 
 
 
 
• **Other Achievements of Mary Kom :**
 
 
• She is the **only Indian female boxer** to have qualified for the **2012 London Summer Olympics** and **won a bronze medal **in the flyweight (51 kg) category. 
 
• She had also been **ranked as the world's No. 1 female light-flyweight** Boxer by the International Boxing Association (amateur) (AIBA).
 
• She became the** first Indian female boxer to win a gold medal** in the** Asian Games in 2014. **
 
• She is the **first Indian female boxer to win gold at the 2018 Commonwealth Games.**
 
• She is a** six-time AIBA Women's Boxing Champion**.
 
 
• AIBA stands for Association Internationale de Boxe Amateur.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6314b9eb342ee1ecdc3898ab415405a27769fb637f6002793599a1fe64160820.png]

questions.question: ________ is the youngest recipient of the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option **4** i.e __**Abhinav Bindra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna now named Major Dhyanchand Khel Ratna Award is the highest sports award in India.
 
 
• Award is named after Rajiv Gandhi, the former Prime Minister of India.
 
• Awarded by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• Instituted in **1991**.
 
• **Viswanathan Anand** is the first recipient of the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award.
 
• Sport shooter Abhinav Bindra is the youngest recipient of the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award.
 
• Last awarded in 2019.
 
• Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award winners 2019:** Deepa Malik and Bajrang Punia**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2024 winners, India's highest sporting honor (formerly known as the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna), are:
 
 
• Shri Gukesh D (Chess)
 
• Shri Harmanpreet Singh (Hockey)
 
• Shri Praveen Kumar (Para‑Athletics)
 
• Ms. Manu Bhaker (Shooting)
